text:
Fixed the task status filter logic on the frontend.

What I changed:
- Updated `public/js/tasks.js` so the selected filter value is passed through correctly to `api.getTasks(...)`.
- Kept the API query logic aligned in `public/js/api.js` so it only adds `?status=...` when a specific status is chosen.

I also ran the test suite to confirm nothing else broke.
